li.label: newblood
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} lay down in the assimilation pod willingly and came out as a different creature. Purebloods call such people newbloods: one of them in body, but not by birth. The memory of the old body fades with time, but {PAWN_possessive} place in society stays one step below those born of the blood.

li.label: remade
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was remade by force: {PAWN_possessive} body was dissolved and rebuilt to a foreign pattern without consent. The remade are the lowest rank of the invaders' society, and purebloods despise them even more than newbloods. The acute shock settles with time, but the scar on {PAWN_possessive} mind never heals.
